description: The contact-solver tuning (see WorldCollision) — it affects the simulation.

requirements.description: The contact qualities the world requires. An empty list permits analytic primitive contact; any declared requirement selects the SDF field.

items.description: A contact quality authored by the world, independent of the engine implementation that supplies it.

contactSkin.description: The signed skin the solver keeps between a body and every surface (world units).

maxIterations.description: The relaxation iteration count per tick (above 8 is a solver pathology, not a choice).

maxSlopeDegrees.description: The steepest surface a body still counts as standing on. A contact whose normal leans further from the body's up axis than this pushes the body but never grounds it — the walkable-slope limit.

gradientProbe.description: The finite-difference step field contact samples the surface normal with, in world units; 0 takes the evaluator's own default. Meaningful only when a requirement selects field contact.
